title: cloud: in-app build (L1 graph-lint) findings carry a producer-written customer sentence (userMessage), parked per #32984 Q1 B
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pmEYLVFDcQ1Z1CS8H

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed. Ruling Q1 B 「B 出问题的一方写客户句」 on #32984 (record 6929121584), parameter 5: the cloud half is parked. ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读

- **是什么：** 云端搭建检查(cloud `service-ai-studio` 的 L1 graph-lint)给出的问题，也要像平台发布检查一样，带一句由产生方按用户语言写的客户句(可选字段 `userMessage`)。
- **为什么暂缓：** 你说过「应用内搭建 cloud 端不着急改」。在它落地之前，草稿问题区继续显示通用句，技术详情折叠。
- **前置：** 平台一半(#32984 Q1 的框架 PR)先合并，字段名和含义以它为准。

## Done when

- Every cloud L1 graph-lint finding the console shows carries an optional `userMessage` in the request's language (request locale, then the workspace default, then `en`), with the same field name and meaning as the platform's `RuntimeBuildIssue.userMessage`. The console's draft-issues block renders it, and a finding without one keeps the generic sentence.

Dedupe words: graph-lint userMessage, cloud build finding customer sentence, service-ai-studio issue language.
